truncate table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE

alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE alter column BNK_CODE	varchar(20);
alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE alter column SOURCE_CODE	varchar(20);
alter table busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE alter column FILE_NAME	varchar(100);


-----UT 1
SELECT TABLE_NAME, 
COLUMN_NAME, 
CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'nvarchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'varchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'char' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'numeric' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'decimal' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('datetime','datetime2', 'date', 'int', 'bigint', 'tinyint', 'float', 'smallint','bit','time') THEN DATA_TYPE
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'bit' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')'
	 END AS DATA_TYPE,
	 LEFT(IS_NULLABLE,1) IS_NULLABLE			 
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE') and TABLE_SCHEMA = 'BUSC'
ORDER BY 1


-------UT2
SELECT 'Source' [TABLE], COUNT(1) FROM d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL WHERE H = 'D'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Target' [TABLE], COUNT(1)  FROM busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE WHERE islatest = 1


--------UT3
SELECT count(1) null_cnt FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
WHERE
ACID IS NULL OR BANK_ID IS NULL OR EOD_DATE IS NULL


--------UT4
WITH SourceData AS (
SELECT STG.[ACID]
,STG.[EOD_DATE] AS EOD_DATE
,[TRAN_DATE_BAL] as TRAN_DATE_BAL
,[TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN] as TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,[VALUE_DATE_BAL] as VALUE_DATE_BAL
,[VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN] as VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,STG.[END_EOD_DATE] AS END_EOD_DATE
,[LCHG_USER_ID]
,LCHG_TIME as [LCHG_TIME]
,[RCRE_USER_ID]
,RCRE_TIME as [RCRE_TIME]
,[TS_CNT] as TS_CNT
,[EAB_CRNCY_CODE]
,STG.[BANK_ID]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm] as insert_dttm
FROM  [D360].[STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL] STG 
where H = 'D'
      )

SELECT COUNT(1) AS MISMATCH_CNT 
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE TGT
WHERE ISLATEST = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM D360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEfull SRC 
    WHERE SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
    AND SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
    AND SRC.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE
);

----------UT5

SELECT ACID, BANK_ID, COUNT(1)  Dup_Count
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE TGT WHERE isLatest = 1
GROUP BY ACID, BANK_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

------UT6
WITH SOURCE AS (
    SELECT
'SOURCE' AS FIELDS
,ISNULL(SUM(CAST(TRAN_DATE_BAL AS numeric(25,4))),0) AS TRAN_DATE_BAL
,ISNULL(SUM(CAST(TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS numeric(25,4))),0) AS TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,ISNULL(SUM(CAST(VALUE_DATE_BAL AS numeric(25,4))),0) AS VALUE_DATE_BAL
,ISNULL(SUM(CAST(VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS numeric(25,4))),0) AS VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
,ISNULL(SUM(CAST(TS_CNT AS numeric(5,0))),0) AS TS_CNT
FROM D360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEfull WHERE H = 'D'
), TARGET AS (
    SELECT
'TARGET' AS FIELDS
,ISNULL(SUM(TRAN_DATE_BAL),0) AS TRAN_DATE_BAL  
,ISNULL(SUM(TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN),0) AS TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN  
,ISNULL(SUM(VALUE_DATE_BAL),0) AS VALUE_DATE_BAL  
,ISNULL(SUM(VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN),0) AS VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN  
,ISNULL(SUM(TS_CNT),0) AS TS_CNT  
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE WHERE ISLATEST = 1
)
SELECT * FROM SOURCE
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM TARGET;
